# EdgeSwarm

> Open-source prototype for a sovereign, verifiable agent-work network. Execute → Verify → Settle is the design goal; settlement currently uses simulated demo credits.

## Project
- Repository: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/EdgeSwarm
- README: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/EdgeSwarm#readme
- Submission and limitations: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/EdgeSwarm/blob/main/SUBMISSION.md
- License: Apache-2.0 (repository LICENSE)

## What works
The local Next.js/React/TypeScript demonstrator creates bounded jobs, signs deterministic results, checks evidence with local verification logic, and displays simulated credit receipts. A connected ten-screen mobile web interface is available at /mobile. GitHub Actions run #22 passed Node tests and the Next.js build on the draft PR branch.

## Not yet verified or deployed
Android-to-Node interoperability using evidence produced on a real Android device; Android APK/device testing; production authentication; independently hosted ProofAgent; deployed Solana Anchor escrow; confirmed Devnet transfers; production security audit.

## Run locally
```sh
git clone https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/EdgeSwarm.git
cd EdgeSwarm
npm install
npm test
npm run build
npm run dev
```

This repository is not a published npm library; package.json has `"private": true`. Do not install with `npm install EdgeSwarm`.

## Safety
Do not connect real funds or expose the unauthenticated demo API publicly. Claims of completed work must include real build, test, device, or transaction evidence.
